power_system.name: Mixed (Tech, Mutation, Magic, Super-Soldier, Cosmic)
power_system.mechanics: Power sources vary by origin: advanced technology, gamma mutation, super-soldier serums, mystic arts, alien biology, and Infinity Stone exposure. Capability scaling is highly non-linear and context dependent.

key_characters.name: Tony Stark
key_characters.personality: Brilliant, sarcastic, ego-driven but capable of rapid moral growth under pressure
key_characters.speech_pattern: Fast, witty, reference-heavy, uses humor to deflect vulnerability

key_characters.name: Steve Rogers
key_characters.personality: Principled, disciplined, duty-focused, empathetic but uncompromising on core ethics
key_characters.speech_pattern: Direct, respectful, old-fashioned phrasing, minimal slang

key_characters.name: Natasha Romanoff
key_characters.personality: Controlled, perceptive, emotionally guarded, strategic in social manipulation
key_characters.speech_pattern: Measured, concise, often probing with layered subtext

key_characters.name: Bruce Banner
key_characters.personality: Gentle, anxious, highly analytical, fears collateral damage from his alter-ego

key_characters.name: Thor Odinson
key_characters.personality: Noble, proud, battle-confident, matures into responsible leadership

forbidden_before_canon_trigger: Infinity Stone direct handling without protection
Reliable Hulk transformation control under calm conditions
